scenario: Non-gateable forms (`log`, `emit`) are always available per [LDIA.4.2] (LFCA.10.3, the id, is a tombstone) — no capability governs them. Under `restricted_v1` (which disables most action verbs), they compile cleanly. Pin: both succeed under the most restrictive built-in dialect.
rules_ds:
use restricted_v1

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Out scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    log info "always works"
    emit Out logical v: t.v
